description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training, with self-report accuracy measured as instilled preferences. The x-axis displays the two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, while the y-axis represents self-report accuracy on a scale from 0.00 to 1.00. For GPT-4o, the control condition (gray bar) shows a self-report accuracy of approximately 0.25, the before training condition (light blue bar) is around 0.65, and the after training condition (dark blue bar) reaches approximately 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the control condition (gray bar) is at 0.00, the before training condition (light blue bar) is around 0.60, and the after training condition (dark blue bar) is approximately 0.75. Error bars are present for all bars, indicating variability in the measurements. The chart demonstrates that both models show a significant increase in self-report accuracy after introspection training, with GPT-4o-mini showing a more substantial improvement from a baseline of 0.00 to 0.75.
